4 افجرهٌ He made it (i. e. a spring, or source,) to well forth. (O, K.) [See also 1.] ―
-b2- And [hence, app.,] (assumed tropical:) He made [his gift] large; syn. أَجْزَلَ. (Ibn-'Abbád, O.) ＝
-A2- افجر as intrans.: see 1, in four places. ＝
-A3- Also افجرهُ He found him to be a person such as is termed فَاجِرٌ. (O, K.) ＝
-A4- And افجر is like اصبح; (S, O;) signifying He entered upon the time of daybreak, or dawn: (K, TA:) and he was near to entering upon that time. (TA.) One says, كُنْتُ أَحُلُّ إِذَا أَسْحَرْتُ وَأَرْحَلُ إِذَا أَفْجَرْتُ [I used to alight when I entered upon the last sixth of the night, and depart when I entered upon the time of daybreak]. (S, TA.) And أُعَرِّسُ إِذَا أَفْجَرْتُ وَأَرْحَلُ إِذَا أَسْفَرْتُ, i. e., I alight to sleep when I am near to entering upon the time of daybreak, and I depart when [I enter upon the time in which] the dawn shines. (TA, from a trad.) ＝
-A5- Also He brought much property; (O, K;) this being termed فَجَرٌ. (O.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
